title: Passenger Attendants
description: Provide services to ensure the safety of passengers aboard ships, buses, trains, or within the station or terminal. Perform duties such as explaining the use of safety equipment, serving meals or beverages, or answering questions related to travel.

tasks.text: Perform equipment safety checks prior to departure.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI can guide safety procedures but human executes driving

dwas.name: Follow safety procedures for vehicle operation.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Explain and demonstrate safety procedures and safety equipment use.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI explains policies; human handles live questions

dwas.name: Explain regulations, policies, or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Signal transportation operators to stop or to proceed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical hand signals to direct vehicle movement

dwas.name: Signal others to coordinate vehicle movement.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Secure passengers for transportation by buckling seatbelts or fastening wheelchairs with tie-down straps.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — In-person comfort and safety assurance

dwas.name: Assist customers to ensure comfort or safety.

tasks.text: Respond to passengers' questions, requests, or complaints.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Transport info lookup automatable; live assistance human

dwas.name: Provide transportation information to passengers or customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Open and close doors for passengers.
Greet passengers boarding transportation equipment and announce routes and stops.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Transport info lookup automatable; live assistance human

dwas.name: Provide transportation information to passengers or customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Provide boarding assistance to elderly, sick, or injured people.
Provide customers with information on routes, gates, prices, timetables, terminals, or concourses.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Transport info lookup automatable; live assistance human

dwas.name: Provide transportation information to passengers or customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Count and verify tickets and seat reservations and record numbers of passengers boarding and disembarking.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

tasks.text: Adjust window shades or seat cushions at the request of passengers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — In-person comfort and safety assurance

dwas.name: Assist customers to ensure comfort or safety.
